text:
lucy.marketing: Heads up team — we're running a mini launch around inference economics next Tue. Need a localized mini-bench kit: single modular infographic (responsive), 4 social tiles, one-pager PDF, and email header. Mike can you drive design + deliver localization-ready Figma?

mike.design: Yep. Any hard numbers and copy, and which langs besides EN? I can set up components for easy text swaps.

anika.product: Final, audited metrics: "2.8x median throughput vs our baseline", "40% token cost reduction", "p95 latency ~110ms". Messaging: low-friction, ops-focused 9avoid model names).

lucy.marketing: Short headline for paid social: "Predictable inference economics" (<=30 chars). Landing headline longer: "Reliable latency and lower unit cost for production LLMs". CTAs: "Register" and "Talk to sales". Localize to FR + DE + ES.

marco.demand: Paid creative constraints: headline <=30 chars, keep primary stat as a single short line for image OCR (e.g., "40% lower token cost"). Need two CTA variants mapped to campaign tags. Also need alt-copy for inbound vs enterprise funnels.

mike.design: noted. Proposed file naming: redwood_mini_bench_YYYYMMDD_LANG_variant.png. Deliverables spec I'll drop into Figma but pasting here: 
```
Deliverables:
- Modular infographic (SVG + 1200x628 PNG responsive artboards)
- Social tiles: 1080x1080 x4 (hero, stat highlight, CTA, logo strip)
- One-pager: A4 PDF 300dpi with TL;DR metrics + 3 callouts
- Email header: 600x200 PNG + 2 text-length variants
- Exports: PNG/JPEG/SVG + source Figma file with text layers editable
- Accessibility: alt text strings for each asset in English, FR, DE, ES
```

legal-bot: Reminder: Do not reference competitor names or unverified third-party data. Use approved palette, icon set, and footer: "Redwood Inference 9 hosted, dedicated, private". Avoid the phrase "best in class" per marketing compliance.

mike.design: I'll create components for the stat bar so translations don't break layout. Initial mock by Thu morning, review Thu afternoon. Will include a QA checklist: color contrast, truncate rules, alt-text examples, export sizes, and naming.

lucy.marketing: Also include a copy sheet with short/long headlines per language (we'll provide localized copy but want the visual space to be ready). Marco — will you confirm paid char limits for DE?

marco.demand: DE paid headline limit is 35 chars, keep that in mind. I'll also draft two short alt-copy variants and paste them into the Figma notes once mock is up.

figma-bot: mike.design uploaded: /files/visuals/1789990000-localized-mini-benchkit-v1.fig

mike.design: Uploaded first pass. Key decisions: stat icon left, metric big center, secondary copy under. If translations push height, we switch to condensed type. Ping me here for quick reviews. :eyes:

lucy.marketing: Reviewing now. If all good I'll route to webinar landing copy and demand gen for ad copy mapping. Thanks team! :rocket:
